title: Acquire selected bath operations on a finite supplied environment
statement: Choi domination gives a physical finite receiver contraction without a supplied least positive Choi eigenvalue.

evidence.quote: ## 6. Finite positive synthesis closes the mode-acquisition problem

requires: Fix finite dimension d and a time-independent Lindblad generator L(rho)=-i[H,rho]+sum_a(L_a rho L_a^dagger-{L_a^dagger L_a,rho}/2), using a canonical TRACELESS Lindblad family and its associated Hamiltonian. N_t=exp(tL); B_t=N_t^c is the FULL PURE-ENVIRONMENT coherent complementary channel. Alice prepares inputs and may retain a reference; Bob receives the complete coherent environmental output; residual source is discarded. Each use has a fresh environment. LOCC and two-way classical communication are available, with NO initial shared entanglement. Q_two-way is qubits per fresh use. Generator/dimension stay fixed as t decreases; a fixed time unit makes log(1/t) dimensionless. Exact rational-complex/algebraic descriptions support the stated branch tests; physical coefficient/interface acquisition is separate.

A known source-channel Choi matrix J, finite factor J=W W^dagger and vectorized selected Kraus columns V with V V^dagger<=J. Physical Kraus-basis coefficient access of corresponding precision is required.
provides: Bessel domination of selected temporal modes and positivity of all remaining trajectory sectors establish V V^dagger<=J. B=W^+ V satisfies W B=V and B B^dagger<=I. The physical receiver success operator is B^T in the stated Choi convention, not an uncharged arbitrary continuum-field projector.

Regularized B_lambda=W^dagger*(J+lambda I)^-1*V remains contractive and obeys ||V-W B_lambda||_F^2<=d^2*lambda/4. SinceTr J=d,condition_2(J+lambda I)<=1+d/lambda. A requested coherent tolerance fixeslambda without a smallest-positive-eigenvalue input.

Selected operators come from fixed-size block matrix exponentials. For a FIXED algebraic generator/canonical finite basis, the source supplies polynomial bit acquisition in the time-description length and log(1/epsilon); constants are generator-dependent. A supplied physical basis still needs coefficient access, precision and implementation.

For KNOWN finite collision models, sequential compression puts the emitted stream into dimension<=d^2 with work linear in collision-unit count at fixed local dimensions. Established tensor-network compression is credited; this does not identify or calibrate an unknown physical bath or robustly decide a class from finite data.
